title: Coefficient presentations with exact native section transport
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $X$ any scheme. There exists CoefficientSystem in the universes of [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-realization-data]: the existing native abelian coefficient is commutative, the existing sections functor is additive and preserves finite limits and colimits, and the normalized CoefficientPresentation family satisfies the completed scalar equation of [lem-sf-locally-finite-adic-coefficient-presentations]. No derived realization functor is part of this data.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2 and native realization section-module transport step 2

proof.text: Use the proved source isomorphism padicAlgClSheafIsoAdicConstantSheaf, whose forward map is a monoid homomorphism. The source coefficient ring is commutative. Cancel the tensor square of the isomorphism; braiding naturality and the multiplication-homomorphism equation prove commutativity for the existing target multiplication, without replacing its monoid structure.

The proved equivalence [lem-sf-native-scalar-forgetting-equivalence] followed by [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence] is precisely the existing sections functor. Equivalences preserve finite limits, finite colimits and zero morphisms; preservation of binary products then proves additivity.
Apply [lem-sf-locally-finite-adic-coefficient-presentations] to this commutative coefficient and package its family and scalar equation with the exact section transport.
